summary: SmartKem, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an additional $2.5 million bridge loan to Ferrox Critical Minerals via a convertible promissory note with 5% interest, maturing December 31, 2026, and a $200,000 origination fee. The note is convertible into Ferrox ordinary shares at the lower of fair market value or a $80 million fully-diluted equity valuation. It includes negative covenants and a right of first refusal on fundamental transactions through year-end. This is a financing arrangement, not a change-of-control deal. No special-situation classification applies.
